submitted.rationale: Index 1 (Sb 0.195) gave the highest measured EQE, 0.039%. The other results were idx0 at 0.023%, idx4 at 0.015%, idx22 at 0.010% and idx14 at 0.008%, so the peak is on the Pb-rich side between Sb 0.15 and 0.32. XRD: the fcc/fluorite-type film phase (a≈5.34 Å; Q≈2.04, 3.33, 3.91) is strongest at low Sb and fades toward Sb 0.5, where the FTO substrate peaks take over. Index 1 also shows weak extra peaks at Q 2.14 and 2.25, from a minor Pb-rich second phase, and this sample has the best EQE.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.023% EQE, lower than idx1; performance drops again at the most Pb-rich end.
Measured 0.015%; EQE falls as Sb increases above about 0.2.
Measured 0.008%; near Pb2Sb2O7 stoichiometry, weak film diffraction, lowest EQE.
Measured 0.010%; the Sb-rich side stays low.
